    # Find separator value (color of uniform rows/cols)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)))) == 1]

    sep_rows_val = set(grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows)
    sep_cols_vals = set(grid[r][sep_c] for sep_c in sep_cols for r in range(len(grid)))

        sep_val = sep_rows_val.pop()
    elif sep_rows:

    elif sep_cols:
        sep_val = sep_cols_vals.pop()
    else:

    all_non_sep = [grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] != sep_val]
    bg_val = Counter(all_non_sep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    
    # Special color (the remaining color that's neither background nor separator)
    all_colors = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])))
    for color, cnt in all_colors.most_common():
